resolved_spec_ambiguities.return_type: simple (P_t/P_{t-1} - 1) — standard event-study convention (MacKinlay 1997); CARs are arithmetic sums of daily ARs
resolved_spec_ambiguities.bar_filter: is_final = 1 only — matches the research/backtest convention; live partial bars (is_final=0) are excluded
resolved_spec_ambiguities.event_day_alignment: t0 = last trading day <= effective_date for that ticker (handles non-trading effective dates and date_precision='month')
resolved_spec_ambiguities.runup_window: AR summed over [idx_announcement .. idx_effective] inclusive — descriptive only, never used in the decision
resolved_spec_ambiguities.insufficient_data: events lacking a full 230td estimation window or a full k=5 reversal window are EXCLUDED and individually reported with a reason — never imputed, never silently dropped
resolved_spec_ambiguities.cr1_dof: t-critical uses df = G - 1 (number of review-date clusters minus one)

decision.rule: REFUTED iff Test 1 fails OR Test 2 fails (HARNESS_SPEC §2, applied verbatim)
